payload: Please address the following before I can approve: 1) Clarify and document the revenue calculation formula (include units and rounding rules) and ensure consistent timezone handling; 2) Add input validation and explicit handling for negative, zero, and extremely large values to avoid overflow/incorrect results; 3) Break the calculation into smaller, well-named functions and improve variable names for readability; 4) Expand unit tests to cover edge cases (zero, negative, very large values, and boundary rounding) and include property-based checks if possible; 5) Ensure error paths return consistent error types and add assertions where appropriate; 6) Update changelog/docs to show example inputs/outputs and complexity notes.

label: Revision
payload:
Revision 2: Addressed CodeReviewer feedback for PR #42:
1) Documentation: added a detailed docblock and docs section describing the revenue calculation formula, units, and rounding rules (bankers/half-even) and included explicit timezone normalization to UTC for all timestamp inputs.
2) Validation & overflow: added input validation (explicit handling for negative and zero inputs), returned a DomainError for invalid inputs, and switched to arbitrary-precision/decimal arithmetic with guards to prevent overflow on extremely large values.
3) Refactor & naming: split the calculation into well-named functions computeBaseRevenue(), applyAdjustments(), and finalizeRounding(); improved variable and parameter names for readability and maintainability.
4) Tests: expanded unit tests to cover zero, negative, very large values, boundary rounding, and edge-cases; added property-based tests to validate invariants across randomized inputs.
5) Error handling & assertions: standardized error types (RevenueError enum), ensured error paths return consistent types, and added assertions to document invariants.
6) Docs & changelog: updated CHANGELOG and user docs with example inputs/outputs, complexity notes, and migration guidance.
All tests pass locally and CI config updated to include property-based tests.

label: Revision
payload:
Revision 3: Addressed SecurityFindings for PR #42:
1) Input hardening: added strict parsing and sanitization for all external inputs, enforced max/min caps to prevent abusive/overflow inputs, and ensured decimals use fixed precision/scale to avoid precision attacks.
2) Error handling: removed sensitive details from error messages, standardized errors to RevenueError with non-sensitive messages, and added safe logging (no PII or raw inputs logged).
3) Dependency & deserialization: upgraded decimal and parsing libraries to patched versions and replaced any unsafe deserialization with a safe parser.
4) Validation & invariants: added defensive checks and runtime assertions to fail-safe on unexpected states; ensured timezone normalization and numeric normalization are atomic and validated.
5) Tests & analysis: added security-focused unit and fuzz tests covering injection, malformed inputs, extreme numeric ranges, and serialization edge cases; ran static analysis and fixed flagged issues.
6) Documentation: documented security assumptions, input constraints, and mitigation strategies in the security section of the docs.
All security tests pass locally and CI security checks updated accordingly.
